messages:
mike_zhang: Heads-up — planning canary deploy for inference-routing v2 at 11:00 PT. I need a quick signoff and smoke owners. Can folks confirm readiness and rollback plan?

sara_cohen: +1 on timing. who is owning smoke for latency and error-rate?

jonah: I can own latency checks. will run the perf script and monitor p95/p99.

priya: I'll watch error rates and logs (sentry + tracing). rollback playbook is here: https://intra.redwood/plays/rollback-inference (read-only link).

mike_zhang: thanks. checklist I'm using: 1) infra green, 2) smoke owners assigned, 3) rollback verified, 4) feature flag ready, 5) canary % set to 5%, 6) pager coverage. pls ack.

jonah: infra green (verified reserved pool & canary routing). :white_check_mark:

priya: rollback verified — practiced on staging last week, tested db migrations are backward-compatible. :white_check_mark:

sara_cohen: feature flag ready, toggle name `routing_v2_canary`. I'll hold the toggle and flip to 5% at start time. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy job: inference-routing:v2 -> canary (5%). ETA 2026-03-18T11:00:00-07:00. CI: passed, smoke job queued.

jonah: smoke test commands I'm running once canary is live:
```
# synthetic load for 2 min
python tools/loadgen.py --qps 20 --duration 120 --endpoint https://api.redwood.dev/generate
# latencies to watch: p95 < 400ms, p99 < 800ms
```

priya: quick log checks I'll tail:
```
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=inference-routing -f --tail=200
# watch for 5xx spike or KV cache errors
```

mike_zhang: Pager coverage confirmed: oncall is @sara_cohen today, escalation to @priya if needed.

sara_cohen: Acknowledged. I'll flip flag at :00 and monitor. If error rate > 0.5% or p99 > 1s for 3 continuous mins, we rollback.

jonah: I'll post metrics at +2m and +10m.

priya: Ready. rollback command is in the playbook, it's a single flag flip + scale down canary. I can run it in <3m.

mike_zhang: OK going to trigger deploy in ~5m. If no objections, this thread is the formal signoff. :white_check_mark:

sara_cohen: Approving — :white_check_mark: go ahead.

jonah: Approving.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: inference-routing:v2 -> canary(5%). Build 2026.03.18.11.00. Logs: https://deploys.redwood/2026/1766543210

mike_zhang: Merge/rollout in progress. tagging this thread for post-deploy notes.

priya: smoke initial pass: error-rate 0.08%, p95 320ms, p99 560ms. All good so far.

jonah: perf looks stable. holding for 10m to confirm.

sara_cohen: keeping flag at 5% for 10m, will increase later if stable.

mike_zhang: Closing signoff — will open follow-up if we ramp or hit anomalies. Thanks everyone. :bow:
